<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#F5F0E8">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="default">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Centro de Mando">
<title>Centro de Mando · Edgar Boone</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 64 64'%3E%3Crect width='64' height='64' rx='12' fill='%231B2A4A'/%3E%3Cpath d='M32 12 L52 32 L32 52 L12 32 Z' fill='%23C5A55A'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" sizes="180x180" href="/icon-180.png">
<link rel="manifest" href="/manifest.webmanifest">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;1,500&family=EB+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#F5F0E8; --surface:#FBF8F2; --surface2:#EFE9DD; --raise:#EBE4D5;
  --line:#DED5C4; --hair:#C5A55A;
  --ink:#1B2A4A; --body:#2E3A52; --muted:#3B4256; --faint:#4E5567;
  --gold:#755A19; --gold-soft:#C5A55A; --gold-deep:#5E4813;
  --c1:#A07A1E; --c2:#2F5AA8; --good:#356038; --bad:#8C4230;
  --serif:'EB Garamond',Georgia,serif; --disp:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;
  --sans:ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--body);font:17px/1.55 var(--serif);
  padding-bottom:calc(106px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
a{color:var(--gold-deep)}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
.hidden{display:none!important}

/* ── cabecera ── */
.top{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:22px 20px 0;text-align:center}
.brand{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:22px;letter-spacing:.34em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.orn{color:var(--gold-soft);letter-spacing:.7em;font-size:9px;margin:6px 0 4px}
.date{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.rule{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--hair) 25%,var(--hair) 75%,transparent);margin:16px 0 0}

/* ── navegación ── */
nav.tabs{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:4px;padding:6px 12px 0}
nav.tabs button{background:none;border:0;padding:12px 14px;font-family:var(--disp);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--body);border-bottom:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer}
nav.tabs button[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--gold-deep);border-bottom-color:var(--hair)}
@media(max-width:720px){
  nav.tabs{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:20;background:var(--surface);
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:4px 4px calc(4px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:0}
  nav.tabs button{padding:10px 2px;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.03em;border-bottom:0;border-top:2px solid transparent;
    white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;min-width:0}
  nav.tabs button[aria-selected=true]{border-top-color:var(--hair)}
}

/* ── contenido ── */
main{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:18px 16px 40px}
@media(min-width:721px){main{padding:24px 20px 60px}}
.view{display:none}.view.on{display:block}
.sh{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin:10px 0 18px}
.sh .lbl{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);white-space:nowrap}
.sh .ln{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line)}
.panel{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;padding:20px 20px 18px;margin-bottom:16px}
.panel h2{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:25px;font-weight:700;color:#142039;margin:0 0 3px;letter-spacing:.01em}
.src{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--body);margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.5}
.note{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted);margin:12px 0 0}
.note b{color:var(--ink)}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
.grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px}
@media(max-width:820px){.grid3{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.sub{display:none}.sub.on{display:block}
.fbloque .colhead{margin-bottom:2px}
@media(max-width:720px){.grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:16px}
@media(max-width:720px){.kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.kpi{background:var(--surface);padding:16px 12px 14px;text-align:center}
.kpi .l{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--body);font-weight:500}
.kpi .v{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:30px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.15;margin:8px 0 3px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.kpi .v.good{color:var(--good)}.kpi .v.bad{color:var(--bad)}
.kpi .n{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.kpi .n .cj{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;padding:1px 0}
.kpi .n .cj b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.kpi .n .cj.src{justify-content:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:3px}
.mv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr auto;gap:6px 10px;align-items:center;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.mv:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.mv .dt{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.mv .ds{color:var(--ink);font-size:15.5px;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.mv .am{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:16px;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
.mv .am.in{color:var(--good)} .mv .am.out{color:var(--bad)}
.mv select{grid-column:2/4;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--gold-deep);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:2px;padding:6px 8px;max-width:100%}
.mv.ok .ds{color:var(--muted)} .mv .tag{grid-column:2/4;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--good)}
@media(max-width:720px){.mv{grid-template-columns:40px 1fr auto}}
.kpis.five{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}
@media(max-width:900px){.kpis.five{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:600px){.kpis.five{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.kpi .when{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--gold-soft);margin-left:4px}
.kpi .d{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.kpi .d.good{color:var(--good)}.kpi .d.bad{color:var(--bad)}
.kpi .spark{width:100%;height:26px;margin-top:6px;display:block}
.units{display:flex;gap:4px;justify-content:center;margin-top:8px}
.units span,.rng span{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer}
.units span.on,.rng span.on{border-color:var(--gold-soft);color:var(--gold-deep)}
.rng{display:flex;gap:6px}
.lec-title{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:24px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.25;margin:8px 0 6px}
.lec-body p{font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--body);margin:0 0 10px;max-width:760px}
.lec-body p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

/* ── tablas y filas ── */
.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:16px}
.tbl th{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--body);text-align:left;
  padding:6px 8px 8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);font-weight:500}
.tbl td{padding:9px 8px 9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top;color:var(--body)}
.tbl tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.tbl .num{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.tbl th.num{text-align:right}
.tbl .who{color:var(--ink)}
.tbl .nw{white-space:nowrap}
.tbl .sub{display:block;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.ais td.q{font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--ink)} .ais td.n{color:var(--muted)} .ais .nm{display:none;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px} .ais .nm::before,.ais td.n::before{content:"✕ ";color:var(--faint)}
@media(max-width:720px){.ais th:nth-child(3),.ais td.n{display:none}.ais .nm{display:block}.ais td.q{white-space:normal}}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:16px}
.row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.row .nm{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;color:var(--ink)}
.row .dt{color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;white-space:nowrap}
.row .amt{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
.row.done .nm,.row.done .amt{color:var(--faint);text-decoration:line-through}
@media(max-width:720px){.row.ed{flex-wrap:wrap}.row.ed input:first-child{flex:1 1 100%!important}}
.row input[type=checkbox]{accent-color:var(--gold-deep);width:18px;height:18px;flex:none;cursor:pointer}
.colhead{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep);
  padding-bottom:7px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);margin:4px 0 4px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline}
.colhead span{font-family:var(--serif);letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;font-size:17px;color:var(--ink);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pill{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:2px}
.pill.ok,.pill.si{background:#DCE8DC;color:#2C4E30}.pill.warn{background:#EDE3CB;color:#5E4813}.pill.off{background:var(--raise);color:var(--faint)}
.pill.bad{background:#F0DDD7;color:#7A3826}

/* ── controles ── */
.btn{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;
  background:var(--ink);color:#F5F0E8;border:0;border-radius:3px;padding:10px 18px}
.btn:hover{background:var(--gold-deep)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--gold-deep);border:1px solid var(--hair);padding:8px 12px;font-size:11.5px}
.btn.ghost:hover{background:var(--ink);color:#F5F0E8;border-color:var(--ink)}
.btn[disabled]{opacity:.5;cursor:default}
.in{font:inherit;font-size:16px;color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:3px;padding:9px 10px;width:100%}
.in:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--hair);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(197,165,90,.22)}
.in.bare{background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0;padding:6px 2px}
.in.bare:focus{box-shadow:none;border-bottom-color:var(--hair)}
.in.num{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
label.f{display:block}
label.f>span{display:block;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--body);margin-bottom:5px}
.msg{background:var(--raise);border-left:2px solid var(--bad);padding:10px 14px;font-size:15px;color:var(--body);margin:8px 0}
.ok{background:#E4EBE4;border-left:2px solid var(--good);padding:10px 14px;font-size:14px;color:#2c4a2e;margin:8px 0}
.subtabs{display:flex;gap:2px;margin:0 0 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.subtabs button{background:none;border:0;padding:9px 14px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1px;cursor:pointer}
.subtabs button[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--ink);border-bottom-color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.chart{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.legend{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 6px}
.legend i{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;vertical-align:-1px;margin-right:6px}
.att{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.att li{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:16px;line-height:1.55}
.att li:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.att i{flex:none;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;margin-top:8px;background:var(--gold-soft)}
.att i.hi{background:var(--bad)}
.att b{color:var(--ink)}
.foco{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.foco:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.foco .d{width:22px;height:22px;border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:2px;flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  color:var(--gold);font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--surface2)}
.foco .d.done{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:#F5F0E8}
.foco input{flex:1}
.foco input.done{text-decoration:line-through;color:var(--faint)}
.mono{font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:13.5px;word-break:break-all;background:var(--surface2);
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:3px;padding:10px 12px;color:var(--body)}
.stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.rowform{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
@media(max-width:720px){.rowform{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.small{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.right{text-align:right}
.flex{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.spacer{flex:1}
.lg{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--body)}
.est{color:var(--gold-deep);font-style:italic;font-size:13.5px;margin-left:4px}
.row.pag .nm,.row.pag .amt{color:var(--faint);text-decoration:line-through}
.row.ed input.in{min-width:0}
.tot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 0 2px;border-top:2px solid var(--hair);font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);flex-wrap:wrap}
.tot b{color:var(--ink);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.row .est{cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
.row .est.off{color:var(--faint);opacity:.55}
.tbl.plan td{padding:4px 8px 4px 0}
.tbl.plan input.in.bare{padding:5px 2px;border-bottom-color:transparent}
.tbl.plan input.in.bare:hover,.tbl.plan input.in.bare:focus{border-bottom-color:var(--hair)}
.tbl.plan tr.totalr td{border-top:2px solid var(--hair);border-bottom:0;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);padding-top:8px}
.tbl.plan .btn.ghost{padding:4px 8px}
@media(max-width:720px){.row.ed input[type=date]{flex:1 1 140px!important}}

/* ── follow up ── */
.fu{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.fu li{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);align-items:flex-start}
.fu li:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.fu .age{flex:none;width:50px;text-align:center;font-family:var(--disp);font-size:23px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1;padding-top:6px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.fu .age s{display:block;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;margin-top:3px}
.fu li.old .age{color:var(--bad)}
.fu li.warm .age{color:var(--c1)}
.fu .bd{flex:1;min-width:0}
.fu .bd input.t{font-size:16.5px;color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--serif)}
.fu .bd .m{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--serif);margin-top:2px;display:block;width:100%;resize:none;overflow:hidden;line-height:1.4;min-height:0;field-sizing:content}
@media(max-width:720px){.fu .bd .m{font-size:16px}}
.fu .tags{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:7px}
.fu select{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep);
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:2px;padding:4px 6px;cursor:pointer}
.fu select:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--hair)}
.fu .x{background:none;border:0;color:var(--faint);font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;padding:2px 6px;line-height:1}
.fu .x:hover{color:var(--bad)}
.fu .lk{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.fu .lk:hover{color:var(--gold-deep);border-bottom-color:var(--hair)}
.cn{margin-top:6px}
.cnt{background:none;border:0;padding:4px 0;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep);cursor:pointer}
.cnt i{font-style:normal;margin-left:6px;color:var(--gold-soft)}
.cnb{display:none;margin:4px 0 2px;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--surface2);border-left:2px solid var(--hair);border-radius:2px}
.cn.on .cnb{display:block}
.cni{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.45;padding:3px 0;color:var(--body)}
.cni b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.cni s{text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:11px;margin:0 4px}
.cna{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:6px}
.cna input{flex:1;padding:7px 9px;font-size:16px}
.fudone{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:15.5px;color:var(--faint)}
.fudone:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.fudone .nm{flex:1;min-width:0;text-decoration:line-through}
.fudone .dt{font-size:13.5px;white-space:nowrap}
.fuadd{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:0 0 14px}
.fuadd input{flex:1}
@media(max-width:720px){.fu .age{width:42px;font-size:20px}}

/* ── aviso de guardado ── */
.saved{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:24px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);opacity:0;
  background:var(--ink);color:#F5F0E8;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:9px 18px;border-radius:20px;transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s;pointer-events:none;z-index:60}
.saved.on{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
.saved.err{background:var(--bad)}
@media(max-width:720px){.saved{bottom:calc(112px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}}

/* ── login ── */
#login{max-width:380px;margin:60px auto;padding:0 20px}
#login .panel{padding:28px 24px}
.footer{max-width:1040px;margin:30px auto 0;padding:0 20px;text-align:center;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.footer button{background:none;border:0;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11.5px;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline}
.skel{height:12px;background:var(--surface2);border-radius:2px;margin:10px 0;animation:sk 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes sk{0%,100%{opacity:.55}50%{opacity:1}}
.tt{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;background:var(--ink);color:#F5F0E8;font-size:14px;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:3px;
  transform:translate(-50%,-125%);white-space:nowrap;z-index:50;display:none}

/* ── app4: pestañas internas, status de libros, vinos ── */
.lstabs{display:flex;gap:2px;margin:0 0 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.lstabs button{background:none;border:0;padding:9px 14px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1px;cursor:pointer}
.lstabs button[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--ink);border-bottom-color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
